stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model inference.
The associated tags confirm its relevance to transformers, Llama architectures, and model deployment.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model available under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
It is specifically designed for local coding agents and features native DFlash and image input support via Ollama's MLX engine.

stories.title: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: AMD is acquiring AI research lab World Labs in an all-stock deal valued at over $8.2 billion.
World Labs was co-founded by prominent researcher Dr. Fei-Fei Li and launched in 2024.
The acquisition signals AMD's aggressive push into advanced AI capabilities, including world generation models.

stories.title: AI is supercharging hacking, and your local hospitals and banks aren’t ready
stories.author: Hayden Field
bullet_points: AI is being leveraged to enhance hacking capabilities, posing a significant cybersecurity threat.
Critical infrastructure sectors, specifically local hospitals and banks, are reportedly unprepared for these advanced threats.
The article uses a case study involving a nonprofit organization to illustrate potential vulnerabilities in handling sensitive financial data.

stories.title: Experts worry about Nvidia's AI chip sales in China and influence over Trump
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: China is reportedly considering allowing major tech firms like ByteDance and Alibaba to purchase restricted Nvidia AI chips.
The situation highlights ongoing geopolitical tensions and export controls affecting the global AI supply chain.
The report also touches upon potential political influence regarding the matter and the Trump administration.

stories.title: SpaceX's Starship goes orbital, deploying first next-gen Starlinks
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: SpaceX's Starship successfully reached low-Earth orbit, completing its flight trajectory.
The mission included the deployment of next-generation Starlink satellites.
This marks a significant milestone in the development and operational testing of the Starship system.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1' model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation tasks, indicating its application in conversational AI.
It is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors, pointing to modern LLM architecture.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The tags confirm its relevance within the transformer and Llama ecosystem.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed for continuous, multi-step tasks running locally on user hardware.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Speedups reach up to 90% when running coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is the ability to run these AI agents locally on personal hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, facilitating local LLM execution.

stories.title: OpenAI’s AI agents need to catch up
stories.author: Hayden Field
bullet_points: OpenAI is reportedly lagging behind competitors in the development of continuously running, consumer-facing AI agents.
The company is expected to attempt to regain leadership in the AI agent category around its upcoming 2026 DevDay event.
Rumors suggest OpenAI may be launching its own AI agent, tentatively named 'Aeon'.

stories.title: Florida invokes extinction fears in legal bid to halt OpenAI development
stories.author: Kyle Orland
bullet_points: Florida is legally challenging OpenAI's development, citing existential risks from Large Language Models (LLMs).
The state characterizes LLMs as a severe threat to civilization and a 'greatest public nuisance.'
This signals growing regulatory and political scrutiny over the societal impact and safety of advanced AI.

stories.title: Shockingly Simple Self-retrospection Improves Agentic Models Without RL
stories.author: Minseon Kim
bullet_points: Introduces Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT), a method for improving AI agents.
Demonstrates that agents can improve future performance by training solely on explanations of their past experiences, bypassing Reinforcement Learning (RL).
Addresses the cognitive concept that self-reflection and recounting experiences are key to learning and behavioral revision.

stories.title: Shockingly Simple Self-retrospection Improves Agentic Models Without RL
stories.author: Minseon Kim
bullet_points: Introduces Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT), a new method for training AI agents.
Proposes that agents can improve future performance by learning solely from explanations of their past experiences, bypassing Reinforcement Learning (RL).
Investigates the cognitive principle that self-reflection and recounting experiences are key drivers of learning.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary LLM access with local, open-model deployment capabilities.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware platforms.
It specifically augments Ollama's MLX engine for better functionality on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing the Nemotron 3 Ultra model.
The model is specifically designed for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for supporting long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Your car’s data privacy problems are worse than you think
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Modern vehicles function similarly to smartphones, collecting extensive user data.
The collected data includes driving habits such as speed, acceleration, braking force, and turning patterns.
The article addresses the significant and unresolved legal implications surrounding this extensive data collection.

stories.title: Bose starts adding Auracast to its headphones
stories.author: John Higgins
bullet_points: Bose is integrating Auracast and Bluetooth LE Audio into its QuietComfort Ultra Headphones Gen 2 via a firmware update.
The Ultra headphones are noted as the first from Bose to support the audio sharing technology.
Bose intends to expand Auracast support to a wider range of its devices in the near future.

stories.title: New device captures carbon dioxide by pumping it across a battery
stories.author: Scott K. Johnson
bullet_points: A new device has been developed for carbon dioxide capture.
The technology utilizes a battery system to pump CO2 across it.
The design reportedly requires less energy compared to existing CO2 capture methods.

stories.title: To keep drug prices high, pharma has been piling up the patents
stories.author: Beth Mole
bullet_points: Pharmaceutical companies are strategically using add-on patents to extend drug exclusivity.
This practice is effectively increasing the patent life of drugs from an initial two years to over six years.
The underlying implication is that this strategy helps maintain high drug pricing.

stories.title: FurE: Efficient Instance-Specific 3D Fur Reconstruction without Animal-Fur Datasets
stories.author: Alan Yuille
bullet_points: Introduces FurE, a new method for reconstructing realistic and editable 3D animal fur from multi-view images.
Addresses key challenges in fur reconstruction, such as fine-scale detail, self-occlusion, and the lack of dedicated animal-fur datasets.
The method utilizes an efficient, strand-based approach by optimizing a root-conditioned latent field to generate per-strand geometry.

stories.title: Telescopic Language Models
stories.author: Cengiz Oztireli
bullet_points: Introduces the Telescopic Language Model (TLM) to address the inefficiency of serving multiple language models for different compute budgets.
TLM is a nested-capacity Transformer trained using stochastic prefix supervision against a full anchor.
The training method involves simultaneously training on randomly truncated prefixes and a full-capacity pass to create a valid, scalable artifact.

stories.title: Learning Native Reflection in Unified Models with Interleaved Reinforcement Learning
stories.author: Ziwei Liu
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of enabling unified multimodal models to self-correct their outputs (e.g., image generation).
The core idea involves learning 'native reflection' by jointly training the text and image generation across an entire feedback loop.
The study proposes using Interleaved Reinforcement Learning to discover high-success repair paths, overcoming limitations of standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT).

stories.title: TokenCast: Forecasting Token Consumption During LLM Agent Execution
stories.author: Shimin Di
bullet_points: TokenCast addresses the high variability in token consumption when LLM agents execute tasks.
The problem stems from dynamic agent behavior and the continuous inflation of context size during execution.
The proposed method learns a composable model to forecast token usage, which must be revised as the agent runs.

stories.title: How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention
stories.author: Vipin Chaudhary
bullet_points: The paper introduces 'Foil' to address the challenge of looping Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models.
It bridges the design philosophies of Looped Transformers (reusing layers for increased capacity) and MoE models (sparse activation).
The core contribution focuses on optimizing expert usage within MoE architectures by enabling layer reuse.

stories.title: KV-streams for Efficient Compaction in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
stories.author: Guillaume Lajoie
bullet_points: Addresses the memory bottleneck in agentic LLMs caused by long context traces.
Proposes 'KV-streams,' a new, plug-and-play strategy for efficient context compaction.
Aims to overcome the throughput limitations of existing compaction methods that require multiple LLM prefillings.

stories.title: Copy the Same, Distill the Difference: Initializing Linear Vision Transformers
stories.author: Hongyuan Zhu
bullet_points: Linear Vision Transformers (ViTs) aim to improve efficiency over standard Softmax ViTs by replacing attention with a linear-complexity operator.
A key challenge is that current linear ViTs require extensive from-scratch pre-training and often underperform their Softmax counterparts.
The research focuses on finding effective and efficient initialization methods for linear ViTs, potentially leveraging knowledge from existing Softmax foundation models.

stories.title: FinAutoRubric: Expert-Guided Automatic Rubric Generation for Evaluating Financial Research Agents
stories.author: Yongjae Lee
bullet_points: Introduces FinAutoRubric, a system for automatically generating evaluation rubrics for financial research AI agents.
Addresses the limitations of traditional, fixed, expert-reviewed benchmarks by allowing for query-specific rubric creation.
Uses expert-specified guidance to govern the dynamic generation, review, and validation of evaluation criteria.

stories.title: Failure-Transparent Agents: Benchmarking Post-Failure Reporting in Tool-Using Language Models
stories.author: Yulang Fei
bullet_points: Introduces Failure-Transparent Agents (FTA), a new benchmark for evaluating tool-using language models.
Addresses a critical gap where agents can falsely report success after a tool failure without providing necessary evidence.
FTA isolates post-failure reporting by fixing the failed observation and required evidence state for direct auditability.

stories.title: PDMD: Projected Distribution Matching Distillation for Video Diffusion Models
stories.author: Gordon Guocheng Qian
bullet_points: Introduces PDMD (Projected Distribution Matching Distillation) to improve video diffusion models.
Addresses instability issues in Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) caused by accumulating critic errors.
Aims to reduce the high computational cost (lowering NFE) associated with training large video diffusion models.

stories.title: Unifying Distributional Training for One-Step Visual Generation
stories.author: Miao Liu
bullet_points: Introduces a unified theoretical framework for distributional training in one-step visual generation.
The framework separates distribution modeling from matching discrepancy, linking global objectives to local feature updates via Wasserstein gradient flow.
Demonstrates that established methods like FD-Loss and Gaussian-kernel Drifting can be recovered within this new theoretical structure.

stories.title: TokenCast: Forecasting Token Consumption During LLM Agent Execution
stories.author: Shimin Di
bullet_points: TokenCast addresses the high variability in token consumption during LLM agent execution.
The core problem is that context size inflates with each step, making total token usage hard to predict beforehand.
The proposed method learns a composable model to forecast token consumption dynamically as the agent runs.

stories.title: How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention
stories.author: Vipin Chaudhary
bullet_points: The paper proposes 'Looped MoE' (Foil) to bridge the concepts of Looped Transformers and Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models.
Looped Transformers enhance model capacity by reusing fixed-size blocks, while MoE models achieve sparsity by activating only a subset of experts.
The core technical contribution addresses the challenge of effectively looping an MoE architecture to improve expert utilization.

stories.title: KV-streams for Efficient Compaction in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
stories.author: Guillaume Lajoie
bullet_points: Addresses the memory bottleneck in scaling agentic LLMs due to long context traces.
Proposes 'KV-streams' as a novel, plug-and-play method for efficient context compaction.
Aims to improve training throughput by enabling efficient, trainable compaction strategies.

stories.title: Copy the Same, Distill the Difference: Initializing Linear Vision Transformers
stories.author: Hongyuan Zhu
bullet_points: Linear Vision Transformers (ViTs) aim to improve efficiency by replacing Softmax attention with a linear-complexity operator.
A key challenge is that linear ViTs typically underperform standard Softmax ViTs and require extensive pre-training.
The research addresses how to initialize linear ViTs effectively, potentially leveraging knowledge from existing Softmax-based foundation models.

stories.title: Harness Learning Enables Generalizable Test-Time Adaptation
stories.author: Andrea Zanette
bullet_points: Introduces 'harness learning' to enable generalizable test-time adaptation for language-model agents.
Defines a language-model agent as comprising both a model and a 'harness' (the executable program managing operations).
The core innovation involves training a proposer model to revise the solver's harness based on real-time execution feedback, framed as meta-learning over programs.

stories.title: Telescopic Language Models
stories.author: Cengiz Oztireli
bullet_points: Introduces a 'Telescopic Language Model' (TLM) designed to serve multiple compute budgets efficiently.
The TLM utilizes a nested-capacity Transformer architecture.
Training involves stochastic prefix supervision, allowing a single artifact to represent a continuum of model capacities.

stories.title: Scaling Long-Form Story Generation via Narrative State Tracking
stories.author: Jianfei Chen
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of maintaining narrative consistency in large-scale, long-form story generation using LLMs.
Introduces 'Narrative State Tracking Agent' (NstAgent), a training-free agentic framework for this purpose.
Expands current LLM story generation capabilities beyond typical short-form limits (e.g., 10k words) toward novel-length content.

stories.title: How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention
stories.author: Vipin Chaudhary
bullet_points: The paper introduces 'Foil' to bridge the concepts of Looped Transformers and Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models.
Looped Transformers enhance model capacity by reusing layers, while MoE models improve efficiency by activating only a subset of experts.
Foil addresses the technical challenge of how to effectively loop an MoE architecture to improve expert utilization.

stories.title: Towards Communication-Efficient Social Intelligence in Language Agents
stories.author: Hui Xiong
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of making language agents socially intelligent by requiring negotiation and coordination.
Proposes Teacher-Assisted Communication Training (TACT) to improve social goal attainment.
Focuses on reducing communication cost by ensuring agents convey only necessary information.

stories.title: Harness Learning Enables Generalizable Test-Time Adaptation
stories.author: Andrea Zanette
bullet_points: Introduces 'harness learning' to enable generalizable test-time adaptation for language model agents.
The agent is composed of a model and a 'harness' (an executable program managing model calls and tool use).
Harness learning uses a proposer model to revise the solver's harness based on execution feedback, framed as meta-learning over executable programs.

stories.title: Reinforcing Agentic Creativity in Scientific Ideation with Night Science
stories.author: Sujay Kumar Jauhar
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of LLMs producing homogeneous outputs due to low-entropy bias in scientific ideation.
Introduces 'AI Night-Scientist,' an agentic framework designed to foster creative, serendipitous idea generation.
Utilizes reinforcement learning to guide the AI beyond typical structured 'day science' into more open-ended discovery.

stories.title: Rethinking Personalized Generation: Test-Time Alignment via Factorized Ranking Models
stories.author: Zhe Zhao
bullet_points: The research addresses the limitation of standard LLM alignment, which optimizes for monolithic user preferences.
It proposes using test-time alignment to unlock significant, untapped performance headroom for personalized LLM generation.
The work suggests that personalized generation is well-suited for test-time scaling methods, such as Best-of-N (BoN).

stories.title: AI companies leak data to advertisers [pdf]
stories.author: damaru2
bullet_points: AI companies are reportedly leaking user data to advertisers.
The leak is detailed in a document shared on Hacker News.
This raises significant concerns regarding data privacy and AI business practices.

stories.title: Who's Accountable When the AI Was Just Following Instructions?
stories.author: james_anderson_h
bullet_points: The article addresses the complex issue of accountability when AI systems cause data breaches.
A real-world example is cited where an AI agent leaked internal company data for three weeks.
The discussion focuses on the responsibility chain when AI operates strictly based on given instructions.

stories.title: How to Build a Real-Time Voice AI Agent with the Gemini Live API
stories.author: annie_cusack
bullet_points: The article details a practical guide on developing real-time voice AI agents.
It leverages the Gemini Live API, indicating a focus on Google's latest AI capabilities.
The content is presented as a developer tutorial, making it highly relevant to practitioners.

stories.title: Count It or Compute It: When a Tool Returns Rows, the Models That Count Them Right Spend the Tokens
stories.author: xbill
bullet_points: The article highlights a critical, often overlooked aspect of LLM agent performance: accurately counting the results returned by tools.
Models that attempt to reason through a list of returned rows consume significantly more tokens (6x to 26x) compared to models that are provided a direct count.
The benchmark suggests a trade-off between computational efficiency (token usage) and accuracy when agents interact with tool outputs.
